title: International Variation in Intergenerational Income Mobility: A Meta-Analysis

yaml.title: International Variation in Intergenerational Income Mobility: A Meta-Analysis
yaml.subtitle: Work in Progress
yaml.abstract: Intergenerational income persistence estimates are sensitive to methodological choices, such as the number of years over which income is averaged, the age at which it is measured, or the set of variables used to predict parental income when it is unobserved. In most cases, data constraints prevent researchers from adopting best practices, limiting comparability across studies. This study systematically compiles national estimates of intergenerational persistence from the literature together with detailed information on their estimation settings. Cross-study variation in these parameters is used to provide a joint assessment of the impact of estimation settings on persistence estimates. Building on these results, national measures are adjusted for methodological differences to provide as consistent a depiction of the variation in intergenerational mobility across countries as possible.

```{r, message = F, warning = F, echo = F} library(tidyverse) # Version 2.0.0 ~ For basic data wrangling library(readxl) # Version 1.4.3 ~ To open Excel files library(sf) # Version 1.0.15 ~ To handle shapefiles and plot maps library(highcharter) #For interactive plot library(viridisLite) library(geojsonio) map_data <- readRDS("sirugue_2026/src/world_map.rds") # GEOM results index <- read_excel("sirugue_2026/src/index.xlsx") shortlist <- read.csv("sirugue_2026/src/shortlist.csv") %>% rbind(read.csv("sirugue_2026/src/shortlist_supplement.csv")) %>% select(paperId, citex) mobility <- read.csv("sirugue_2026/src/world_view.csv") %>% filter(estimator == "IRA") %>% mutate(country = ifelse(country == "United States", "United States of America", country)) %>% select(name = country, paperId, mobility = estimate, source) %>% left_join(shortlist, by = "paperId") %>% mutate(handle = gsub(",.*$", "", citex), handle = gsub("^.*\\{", "", handle), cite = paste0("[@", handle, "1]"), plotcite = paste0(gsub("[^0-9]*$", "", handle)), plotcite = paste0(substr(plotcite, 1, nchar(plotcite) - 4), " (", substr(plotcite, nchar(plotcite) - 3, nchar(plotcite)), ")"), handle = gsub(",.*$", "", citex), cite = ifelse(grepl("2023OnlineAF", cite), "[@ELIKSAH2023OnlineAF1]", cite), cite = ifelse(cite == "[@Greenaway‐McGrevy2024TemporalAR1]", "[@GreenawayMcGrevy2024TemporalAR1]", cite)) %>% mutate(plotcite = ifelse(plotcite == "daza (2021)", "Daza Baez (2021)", plotcite), plotcite = ifelse(plotcite == " ()", "Eriksen (2020)", plotcite), plotcite = ifelse(plotcite == "delpozo (2024)", "Del Pozo (2024)", plotcite)) %>% mutate(plotcite = case_when(plotcite == "Acciari (2019)" ~ "Acciari et al. (2019)", plotcite == "Ahrsjo (2023)" ~ "Ahrsjo et al. (2023)", plotcite == "Britto (2022)" ~ "Britto et al. (2022)", plotcite == "Clemente-Casinhas (2024)" ~ "Clemente-Casinhas et al. (2024)", plotcite == "Del Pozo (2024)" ~ "Del Pozo et al. (2024)", plotcite == "Deutscher (2019)" ~ "Deutscher and Mazumder (2019)", plotcite == "Elk (2024)" ~ "Elk et al. (2024)", plotcite == "Fan (2015)" ~ "Fan et al. (2015)", plotcite == "Kaila (2024)" ~ "Kaila et al. (2024)", plotcite == "Kenedi (2023)" ~ "Kenedi and Sirugue (2023)", plotcite == "Chu (2020)" ~ "Chu and Lin (2020)", plotcite == "ELIK¸SAH (2023)" ~ "Eliksah et al. (2023)", plotcite == "leites (2022)" ~ "Leites et al. (2022)", .default = plotcite)) data <- index %>% # Drop Chile 2009 which is not comparable because it has more circumstances filter(!(c == "CHL" & y == 2009)) %>% select(name, c, iso, y, latest, var) %>% na.omit() %>% mutate(y = as.numeric(y)) %>% filter(latest == 1) %>% select(name, c, iso, y, var) %>% mutate(name = ifelse(name == "Czech Rep.", "Czech Republic", name)) %>% full_join(mobility, by = "name")%>% mutate(iso = case_when(name == "Canada" ~ "CAN", name == "Russia" ~ "RUS", name == "Taiwan" ~ "TWN", name == "Turkey" ~ "TUR", name == "Uruguay" ~ "URY", .default = iso)) %>% select(iso, mobility, plotcite, source) %>% na.omit() stops <- data.frame( q = 0:9 / 9, c = viridis(10, direction = -1, option = "G"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE ) stops <- list_parse2(stops) highchart(type = "map") %>% hc_add_series_map( map = map_data, df = data, joinBy = c("iso-a3", "iso"), value = "mobility", name = "Intergenerational persistence", borderColor = "#FAFAFA", borderWidth = 0.1, tooltip = list( pointFormat = "{point.name}: {point.value}
Source: {point.plotcite} [{point.source}]", valueDecimals = 2 ) ) %>% hc_colorAxis(stops = stops, min = min(data$mobility, na.rm = T), max = max(data$mobility, na.rm = T)) ```
